steps.content: Cellar
[Cellar]
Footsteps echo, swallowed by the oppressive darkness of the tunnel.
Hey...? I'm here.
I saw the signal you hid. Where are you—?
In the suffocating quiet, every sound carries. A moment later, a series of sharp, metallic taps ring out from the pipes within the walls.
(Clank, clank, clank, clank—)
****. Always with the games.
Swallowing his frustration, he raises his own fist and begins to answer in kind, rapping a sequence against the pipe.
[Scene Change: Main Hall, Upbeat BGM]

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: ...Yes, spies come in many varieties. The most common are local assets. People living ordinary lives, only activated when needed.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: Then there are the infiltrators, planted into specific departments. They require an elaborate cover and a full support system to maintain.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: A man like Marlo is what we call "deep cover." Do you have any idea what it cost him? How many people he had to kill to earn his place in that gang?
With a slight sway, Helene sets her glass down and leans into your space, her movements softened by drink.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: So yes, he's a bad person. I'm hardly surprised.
With a subtle shift of your weight, you evade her touch. Your face betrays nothing.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sounds like you really hate him.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: Of course. Isn't he the one who made me who I am today?
As if catching her own loss of composure, she grabs the wine bottle and shakes it. Nothing sloshes inside. It is empty.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: Talking with you is so... refreshing, Officer. I'll go fetch another bottle...
She sways to her feet, but her movement freezes mid-step, her attention seized by something beyond the window.

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: Hey... wh-what's that?
[Exterior, Rain, Fire Effect]

steps.speaker: Helene
steps.content: Look! Is the annex on fire?!

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Oh my... It appears so... But in this downpour, and given the manor's brick and stone construction, it should have considerable fire resistance...

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: No! That's the depot with the fuel reserves—
BOOOOM!

A thunderous explosion tears through the air outside the window—gunpowder, oil barrels, it's impossible to tell. The shockwave is a physical force, slamming through the main building and hurling objects to the floor.

Before the deafening roar has even faded, a wave of heat and light follows. Flames surge, and thick, billowing smoke immediately begins to choke the air, rolling relentlessly toward the main building.

steps.speaker: Manphist
steps.content: Not again! Guards! Where are the guards?! Open this door at once! Let us out! This whole place could go up!
Manphist screams, throwing his weight against the locked door in a frenzy.
Then, a second blast erupts directly beneath your feet.
This is another attack! More brutal and dangerous than anything from this morning.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Everyone, stay calm! The attack is currently confined to the annex! Reinforcements have been dispatched. All main hall personnel, follow us to the shelter immediately!

steps.speaker: Nolaine
steps.content: That ******* mole! This time you won't get away!
With an angry roar, Nolaine charges through the doorway and into the smoke.
Helene's hand finds yours, her grip tight with panic.
